page.overview:
Who is Sherry Polnareff?

[http://www.animenewsnetwork.com/encyclopedia/people.php?id=3125 Naoko Ishii] (Arcade)[http://www.animenewsnetwork.com/encyclopedia/people.php?id=14633 Sayuri Kubo] (OVA) (Anime)

Sherry Polnareff is a young pretty woman of slim build who has long and curly dark hair. She has similar eyes to her brother and is above-average in height, but other than that, there isn't much they have in common. In the anime, she dons a school uniform and carries a pink frilly umbrella.

Upon being "revived" by Judgement, she/her golem has a vacant stare and appears naked; however, once Polnareff gets too close, it reveals a grotesque unfinished right side of Sherry's face. A glowing red mass sits in its eye socket.

Only a teenager when her life was cruelly cut short, on a stormy walk home with her friend, Sherry was raped and murdered by J. Geil. The authorities did not believe the testimony of her friend who survived the attack and their assailant, leading to Polnareff's desire to seek her killer to exact revenge. She seemed to have gotten along well with her brother, as he frequently carries her picture with him.
